description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs: CertPool wraps Vec<Certificate> and exposes .add(), .len(), .is_empty(). Missing: impl IntoIterator (or impl Iterator) so callers can write 'for cert in &pool' instead of 'for cert in pool.certs.iter()' (which they can't do at all — certs is private). Also missing: impl Index<usize>, impl FromIterator<Certificate>. A type that is naturally a collection should implement the standard Rust collection traits. At minimum, IntoIterator for &CertPool is needed for callers to inspect or debug the pool contents.
title: CertPool lacks Iterator impl — callers must call .iter() to iterate
